subject.title: BL-shipping-costs-07: el checkout no valida en servidor el coste de envío ni el total enviados por el cliente

question: Should checkout amount mismatches fail closed before persistence, or should the server recalculate and overwrite the submitted totals?
rationale: Both choices fix the client-trust boundary, but they have different customer-facing failure behavior, analytics impact, and compatibility implications for cached checkout clients.

options.title: Reject mismatches before save
options.body: Return a clear 400-style checkout error when client-sent shipping or total differs from the server calculation, preventing underpayment and surfacing stale client bugs.

options.title: Recalculate and overwrite totals
options.body: Persist and charge the server-calculated values while logging the discrepancy, reducing customer interruption but hiding client drift unless monitored.

options.title: Sequence after BL extraction
options.body: Wait for the draft BL extraction PR to land first, then implement the enforcement as a smaller follow-up on top of the shared pure functions.

recommendation.title: Reject mismatches before save
recommendation.body: Return a clear 400-style checkout error when client-sent shipping or total differs from the server calculation, preventing underpayment and surfacing stale client bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue came from the Shipping Costs BL owner workflow, and the decision affects the validated BL spec for this rule.
